focus: Interior completeness improvement using only fixture-like symbols visible on the Purdue 2018 typical Levels 2-4 raster plan.

source.title: Engineering and Polytechnic Gateway Formation Study, massing studies draft including landscape
source.interpretation: Two compact fixture banks are visually interpreted as washrooms. One bank has four basin-like marks and four toilet-like marks; the other has three basin-like marks and two toilet-like marks. The sheet provides no fixture legend or schedule, so type/count interpretation is moderate confidence, not confirmed room use or as-built condition.

asset_changes.position_method: Centers follow the symbol-center pixels in typical_plan_fixture_candidates_r12.json transformed through the existing hand-registered plan affine (~+/-1 m). The typical plan is repeated on L2-L4 only.
asset_changes.geometry_and_material: Very simple toilet/basin stand-ins and neutral material are display placeholders, not measured fixture design. Sizes, height, plumbing, material/finish, fixture orientation beyond schematic placement, operability, and current room use are not specified by the plan.
not_changed: exterior facade cadence or material mapping
doors, stairs, partitions, or existing shell geometry

visual_evidence.presentation_limit: The plan crops provide the strongest location evidence. 3D fixture meshes are sparse schematic placeholders; the cutaway is illustrative and not an as-built interior render.
